menu_options.inside: Inside Home Assistant (needs an Ollama server; 1-3 GB of RAM)
menu_options.connect: Connect to a seat running elsewhere

inside.title: The model server
inside.description: The seat thinks with an Ollama server. Home Assistant has no Ollama integration set up, so give its address (this machine or another one on your network).

models.title: Models
models.description: The Ollama server at {backend} ({source}). Pick one model to talk with and one to embed text for the field.

connect.title: An existing seat
connect.description: The seat's serve address. Password: the seat token (run `membrane token seat` on the seat); a seat on another machine needs it for everything that writes. Or the pair a reverse proxy in front of it asks for.

error.no_ollama: No Ollama server answered at that address.
error.no_models: That Ollama server has no models yet: `ollama pull` one to chat with and one embedding model.
error.cannot_connect: The seat didn't answer (wrong address or pair).

init.title: Membrane
init.description: The house talks to one seat at a time; switch it from membrane home's 🦠 zoo or the Membrane seat entity.

data.embed_model: Embedding model (best left as it is once the field has grown: its memories were embedded with it)
data.ha_access: Let the seat use Home Assistant (read states, call services, sense changes of the entities it mirrors) -- its own hidden, non-admin user
data.ha_base_url: Home Assistant's address as the seat sees it (detached seats call this; empty: HA's own answer)
data.landing: Open on membrane home (folds HA's sidebar away, as on the boat)
data.stt_url: Speech server URL (whisper-server; empty: the browser listens itself)

add_seat.title: Add a seat
add_seat.description: Another seat for the zoo -- a laptop, a phone, a server running `membrane`. Its token: run `membrane token seat` on that seat.

data.host: Host (the seat's address on your network, e.g. 192.168.1.107)
data.serve_port: Serve port (4096: the seat's chat and field surface)
data.proxy_port: Proxy port (11500: the seat's model proxy)
data.token: Seat token (`membrane token seat` on the seat): a seat on another machine needs it for everything that writes
data.name: Name (empty: its Blurp's own name, else the host)
data.stt_url: Speech server for this seat (empty: the house's)

edit_seat.title: Edit {seat}
edit_seat.description: The seat's address, ports and token (`membrane token seat` on the seat); Home Assistant's own seat takes a name only.

data.host: Host (the seat's address on your network, e.g. 192.168.1.107)
data.serve_port: Serve port (4096: the seat's chat and field surface)
data.proxy_port: Proxy port (11500: the seat's model proxy)
data.token: Seat token (`membrane token seat` on the seat): a seat on another machine needs it for everything that writes
data.name: Name (empty: its Blurp's own name, else the host)
data.stt_url: Speech server for this seat (empty: the house's)

remove_seat.title: Remove a seat
remove_seat.description: Home Assistant's own seat stays; the last seat stays.
